reviews.comment:
This is for MEEN 472.

Dr. Cooper was very organized and taught the material well. She learned our names and did her best to give examples and applications of the lecture content. This class was very difficult but very rewarding and I learned a lot about gas dynamics.

She is very well versed in the material. Pop quizzes are very frequent, no exam review questions or review material unless other professors provide it, homework is graded very strictly, exams are tough and few people excel in the class. 3/74 students had an A in the class after the second midterm. Curve at the end likely saved many (including me).

She obviously knows what she's talking about and expects you to know as well, even though this is an intro class. She doesn't work with you at all and adheres to her Kate work policy like her life depends on it. You could die and she still wouldn't excuse you. She also gave no review whatsoever and put stuff on final exam we had never covered!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Homework is hard to figure out due to never really seeing examples in notes or in lectures. She gives no exam preparation or even gives the slightest hint of what to expect. Our class got a 40-point curve on an exam to bring the average to a 75. The formula sheet given on the exam was useless on the first test. If you get her, pray.

Dr. Cooper is a knowledgeable professor with a lot of experience in the industry. Her assignments are overall not too difficult but the exams are very difficult. Each of the exams was given a heavy curve so overall it is hard to perform well in the class. There are participation quizzes in class almost daily and are worth a lot of the grade.

Shes a new professor, so her first semester may have just been rough. She has a lot of real world experience but that doesnt transfer to teaching ability. She gave us a weekend to read a 20 page technical report and do a programming assignment which most 90+% couldnt. Definitely the hardest MEEN course I have ever taken. Be warned!
